metadata.description: savvy-flow, a 40K-themed fork of savvy-progress (johnnyvizz/claude-kit, MIT) and two of Anthropic's example mods: Blast Radius and Replay Theater (Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Skill: plan, delegate to tiered worker subagents, review.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel; made for savvy-flow, shows any subagents. 40K costumes and Librarium colours.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Mod (Anthropic, unchanged): holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Mod (Anthropic, unchanged): step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.
